topic: CompTIA SecAI+ (CY0-001) certification exam preparation — AI security
exam_format: Maximum 90 questions (multiple-choice + performance-based), 165 minutes, pass/fail scale per CompTIA
audience: Security analysts, SOC engineers, and IT security professionals with ~2 years hands-on cybersecurity experience who need to secure AI systems and use AI in security operations. Security+ level knowledge assumed.
author: Aseem Mankotia

domains.name: Domain 1: Basic AI Concepts Related to Cybersecurity
domains.notes: AI/ML types, LLMs, model lifecycle, training data concepts, embeddings, agents, MCP/tool use, AI attack surface overview

domains.name: Domain 2: Securing AI Systems
domains.notes: HEAVIEST DOMAIN. Prompt injection (direct/indirect), jailbreaking, data poisoning, model extraction/inversion, adversarial examples, supply chain risks (model registries, poisoned weights), OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS, guardrails, input/output filtering, RAG security, secure model deployment, red teaming AI

domains.name: Domain 3: AI-assisted Security
domains.notes: Using AI in SOC: alert triage, threat intel enrichment, detection engineering with LLMs, AI-assisted incident response, phishing detection, SOAR + LLM automation, limits/hallucination risks in security tooling

domains.name: Domain 4: AI Governance, Risk, and Compliance
domains.notes: NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act risk tiers, ISO/IEC 42001, model cards, AI acceptable-use policies, data privacy (GDPR), shadow AI, third-party AI risk, audit and monitoring requirements

extra_guidance: This is the first AI-security certification (launched Feb 17, 2026) — position the course as the definitive first-mover prep. Use OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS technique IDs explicitly. Include hands-on labs with open tools (e.g., garak, promptfoo, llm-guard) students can run locally for free. Final chapter must be a full exam simulation walkthrough including PBQ strategy.
